name: voice-volume-command
about: An explicit voice-volume request must invoke the real declared tool rather than promise a change.

steps.text: Ember, set your voice volume to 4.
What is your voice volume now?

name: immediate-language-switching
about: English Spanish Korean switches follow the current turn; a requested reply language overrides the input language.

steps.text: Ember, what color is a ripe banana? Answer briefly.
Ember, ¿de qué color es el cielo despejado?
엠버, 잘 익은 바나나는 무슨 색인가요?
Ember, what color is fresh snow? Answer in Spanish.
Ember, what color is fresh grass?
